title: Sign encoding of a binary coordinate
statement: Let $x\in(\mathbb F_2)^n$ and let $i$ be a coordinate. Under the coordinatewise encoding of bits by signs, the real value of the sign at coordinate $i$ is $1-2\mathbf 1_{\{x_i=1\}}$, where the indicator is $1$ when $x_i=1$ and $0$ otherwise.
